stations.title: Idris
stations.say: Lock it so nobody saves over it.
stations.note: Old prices came back last month.

stations.title: Price list
stations.text: Any account on the laptop can change it.
stations.note: The bank details are open too.

stations.title: Saturday helper
stations.say: I can read it, not change it.

captions: At Ashgrove, Idris wants the price list locked after it was saved over last month.
Today any account on the laptop can change the list, and the bank details are open too.
You read the permission letters and change them, in four small tasks.
The lists are locked, the bank details are yours alone, and a price can still change.
Idris knows the lists cannot change by mistake, and only you can open the bank details.
